comment: mon.c wiz_force_cham_form() 5151 and validvamp() 5053-5056, the S_VAMPIRE class arm: a vampshifter whose last monpolycontrol answer is the vampire class 'V' after every V species but Vlad is genocided, so mkclass_poly() returns NON_PM and validvamp() falls back to the monster's own form (mon->cham). A debug Valkyrie (monpolycontrol, !confirm) reads a blessed scroll of genocide for class V (Vlad is unique and survives), puts on a +60 ring of increase accuracy, creates a sleeping Vlad the Impaler (forcing him over the doppelganger substitute), turns into a water nymph and steals his Candelabrum (without it, validvamp() does not override the choice at 5034). Vlad kills her repeatedly (debug mode declines each death); once she is blindfolded, Vlad cannot be seen, so decide_to_shapeshift() shifts him (m_calcdistress) and the monpolycontrol prompt takes 'V' five times.
